method: Format-preserving, fixed 16-slot column decode microbenchmark; reverse preorder; unmodified production tree. Rebase span/start column to zero iff all live values fit u8. End column unchanged. Four variants and four kernels; rotating/reversing variant order; two passes with reversed file order. Not end-to-end iterator timing.

build.flags: -O2 -g -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -Werror; SQ_GROUP_SIZE=16; points enabled; no LTO; scalar functions disable autovectorization
